mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, run_id, role, sequence_no, visible_to_user, content_summary, create_time, create_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_message (conversation_id, run_id, role, sequence_no, visible_to_user, content_summary, create_time, create_by) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{runId}, #{role}, #{sequenceNo}, #{visibleToUser}, #{contentSummary}, #{createTime}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_message WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY sequence_no ASC, id ASC
